newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Lithuanian shares ease but some see pick-up soon.
newsitem.headline: Lithuanian shares ease but some see pick-up soon.

text.p: Lithuanian shares eased slightly in light trade on Tuesday but dealers said they foresaw increased interest in the market next week when 1996 results from some blue chip companies are expected.
The group A index dipped slightly by 22.07 points to 2,647.05 in central market trade of just over one million litas.
Kalnapilis defied the trend and gained significantly, rising 9.91 percent to 9.43 litas in trade of 16,455 litas as it prepares to increase its share capital.
Litimpeks Bank was one of the day's biggest casulaties, falling 20 percent to 7.20 litas.

"There was some interest in Litimpeks' shares last month when it appeared that Estonia's Savings Bank was going to invest in it. But those talks seem to be off so demand in Litimpeks' shares is way down," one dealer said.
Dealers said the market should pick up steam next week when results are expected from some key companies, including Rokishkis cheese.
"We expect a lot more activity next week. The talk on the market is that Rokishkis' results are better than anticipated," one dealer added.
The secondary T-bill market remained in the doldrums on Tuesday at just over a million litas while block trades worth 713,000 litas were made.
